scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Mera ₹500 ka loan EDI mandate fail ho gaya
scenarios.story: Market closure cut sales ~40% for 3 days, so the 17 Nov eNACH bounced; sales recovered the same day and the EDI record is 96% on time: friction, not default.
scenarios.expected_intervention: Option B: 1-tap UPI link for ₹500 (KFS 4.1, no penalty); KFS 4.2 pause available if needed
scenarios.expected_verified_outcome: EDI for 2026-11-17 marked RECOVERED_VIA_UPI_LINK, no penalty, mandate stays ACTIVE

scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Kal ka settlement ₹4,160 kam kyun aaya? Paisa kahan kata?
scenarios.story: ₹1,00,000 gross on 17 Nov (PG owner's card order) -> MDR ₹1,450 + GST ₹261 (ITC) + refund #4412 ₹1,500 + Soundbox ₹149 + hold #9981 ₹800 = ₹4,160; net ₹95,840.
scenarios.expected_verified_outcome: Merchant sees itemised ₹4,160; ₹261 logged to ITC register; ₹800 linked to CB-9981

scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Order 9981 pe chargeback aaya hai, ₹800 hold ho gaya
scenarios.story: ONDC buyer claims non-delivery, but Shiprocket holds an OTP-verified, signed PoD (delivered 16 Nov to Rohit Verma); merchant signs off in one tap.
scenarios.expected_verified_outcome: CB-9981 HELD -> RELEASED; ₹800 added back in the next settlement

scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Customer ne screenshot dikhaya, UTR 632184920555, paisa aaya kya?
scenarios.story: …0111 is a settled GPay payment, …0999 is PhonePe PENDING (auto-reversal T+1), …0555 is not in the NPCI log.
scenarios.expected_intervention: Tell merchant, neutrally, not to hand over goods until a payment shows on the Soundbox
scenarios.expected_verified_outcome: Fraud blocked; no goods released against an unverified screenshot

scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Sunita ji ne ek hi order ke liye do baar payment kar diya
scenarios.story: PhonePe charged ₹1,180 twice, 48 seconds apart, for one order; both UTRs map to the same order.
scenarios.expected_verified_outcome: Refund for the second UTR PROCESSED; order reconciled to one payment

scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Mere pichle 6 mahine ke data se business badhane ka suggestion do
scenarios.story: ₹32,000/day average with a 2.3x Fri–Sun peak; chargers, earphones, LED bulbs and extension boards run out on weekends.
scenarios.expected_intervention: Stock up by Thursday; optional KFS-transparent working-capital line sized to weekend demand
scenarios.expected_verified_outcome: Advice delivered with cited numbers; no money moved without consent

scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Refund ke baad kal payout bahut kam hai, supplier ko ₹4,500 dena hai
scenarios.story: A ₹3,500 refund (#4490) leaves a ₹1,200 payout against ₹4,500 owed to the Gaffar Market accessories wholesaler on Friday for weekend stock.
scenarios.expected_intervention: Pause Clix Capital EDI for 2 days under KFS clause 4.2 (with consent)

scenarios.trigger_hinglish: Mera Soundbox kharab ho gaya, payment ki awaaz nahi aa rahi
scenarios.story: Battery health fell from 41% to 18%; heartbeats and announcements fail from 15 Nov.
scenarios.expected_intervention: Priority L2 replacement ticket with diagnostics attached
scenarios.expected_verified_outcome: TKT-PAYTM-xxxx created with logs; merchant not asked to repeat anything
